decision: The existing C11 repository, query executor, I03/I05/Batch consumers and compact lane can use the existing W03 compact/selective event representation. The only missing owner is the canonical Parquet carrier's persisted compact sidecar and reopen_compact path.
supported_seam: persist_compact -> compact selector/body/group sidecar in the release directory -> reopen_compact builds _CompactPublicObjects -> C11Repository stores _EventLocator -> CarrierNeutralResearchExecutor/BatchExecutionRunner use the exact release -> _ReleaseIndex/_select_respondent_events/_semantic_value materialize only selected events -> exact EmpiricalFact for the existing FieldForge receiving owner.
boundary: No whole MCR/12-ID/final code/economic acceptance; no source/native/science/actor authority; no new engine/DuckDB; no production edit in this review.

evidence: ParquetC11Carrier._relation_objects iterates release.public_objects and persist/_write_tables writes full relation tables; for _CompactPublicObjects this materializes every event. reopen reads all RELATION_SPECS + release_identity through _read_rows (whole-table lists), reconstructs every row through _object_from_row, and calls _make_validated_release; there is no compact reopen branch or streamed row reader.
additional_gaps: No canonical compact selector/body/group sidecar; c11-events-*.parquet is body-only, policy-bound and disposable, and _read_bodies requires in-memory selectors.
_EventRead has no universe/respondent group fields; _CompactPublicObjects has no persisted-row constructor.

The event relation logical digest is global over full sorted rows; a compact sidecar cannot recompute it without the full event rows unless a stream-equivalent digest or admission-time binding is used.
not_a_blocker: FieldForge consumes EmpiricalFact, not C11 events

persist_checks: Full manifest hash/schema; member SHA-256; relation digests; release/source/semantic/replay identity
admission-time full event relation digest for compact-only, or full event table member hash if retained
compact_open_checks: Manifest hash/schema/member hashes including full event table if retained
retained_once_validated: C11Repository exact object index may hold _EventLocator
ordering: Full tables sort by (object_family, object_id); compact entries/by_respondent sort by exact event key/ref key; existing eager/cold tests match selector sequence/yield and I03/I05 material.
logical_digest: canonical_json is deterministic sorted JSON; _logical_digest hashes canonical_json(rows). A stream-equivalent digest can reproduce the exact array in persisted row order; the full event relation digest cannot be recomputed from compact selectors alone, so compact-only binds it at admission/persist. Strict mode may stream full event rows.
semantic_validation: m01_m18/replay/source/authority/closure validation is metadata/ref-level; full I02 semantic validation stays at construction/admission. No semantic change or trusted cache.
